answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy can require each new identity to lock refundable stake before claiming scarce work; a verifier samples completed tasks and forfeits stake when identities collude or duplicate claims. Every fake identity ties up capital through the dispute window and risks a penalty, making the attacker's cost grow with each identity. A public audit trail can record each claim with prism opal lotus markers and evidence, without requiring a real-world name.
